component.name: DropdownMenu
component.description: Triggered action menu anchored to its child content.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Element users activate to open the menu.

slots.name: overlay
slots.description: Optional backdrop rendered behind modal menu content.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Positioned menu panel that contains groups, items, and submenus.

slots.name: group
slots.description: Section wrapper for related menu items.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Heading text for a menu group.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Action row inside menu content, including checkbox and radio items.

slots.name: itemLeading
slots.description: Leading icon or visual shown for a menu item.

slots.name: itemWrapper
slots.description: Text column that groups menu item label and description.

slots.name: itemLabel
slots.description: Primary text for a menu item.

slots.name: itemDescription
slots.description: Supporting text for a menu item.

slots.name: itemTrailing
slots.description: Trailing region for shortcuts, submenu arrows, or selection indicators.

slots.name: itemKbds
slots.description: Container for keyboard shortcut hints at the end of a menu item.

slots.name: itemIndicator
slots.description: Checked or selected-state indicator for checkbox and radio menu items.

slots.name: itemSub
slots.description: Indicator shown when a menu item opens a submenu.

own.name: checkedIcon
own.description: Icon used for checked checkbox items.

own.name: children
own.description: Trigger content used to open the dropdown menu.

own.name: contentBottom
own.description: Content rendered after the resolved item groups.

own.name: contentTop
own.description: Content rendered before the resolved item groups.

own.name: defaultOpen
own.description: Initial open state when the component is uncontrolled.

own.name: disabled
own.description: Whether trigger interactions should be ignored.

own.name: gutter
own.description: Gap between the anchor and the content.

own.name: id
own.description: Unique base id used to derive trigger and content ids.

own.name: items
own.description: Items rendered in the menu body.

own.name: onOpenChange
own.description: Called whenever the menu requests an open state change.

own.name: open
own.description: Controlled open state of the menu.

own.name: overflowPadding
own.description: Padding applied to the overflow area when calculating the menu's position.

own.name: placement
own.description: Preferred content placement relative to the trigger or anchor point.

own.name: preventScroll
own.description: Whether body scroll should be locked while the menu is open.

own.name: submenuIcon
own.description: Icon used for submenu trigger items.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state for checkbox and radio items.

props.name: children
props.description: Nested menu items for creating submenus.

props.name: color
props.description: Color theme variant for the menu item.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state for uncontrolled checkbox and radio items.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary description text displayed below the label.

props.name: group
props.description: Radio group identifier. Radio items with the same group are mutually exclusive.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon name or custom element to display at the start of the item.

props.name: kbds
props.description: Array of keyboard shortcuts to display as keys.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Event handler called when a checkbox item's state changes.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Event handler called when the item is activated.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Event handler called when a radio item is selected.

props.name: type
props.description: The type of menu item to render.

props.name: value
props.description: Radio item value reported by onValueChange and used for grouped selection.
